choose.when: select 'file' resource_type,concat('',r.id) id,r.display_name title,r.mime body, (select group_concat(t.name order by t.normalized_name separator ',') from px_resource_tag_rel rel join px_resource_tag t on t.id=rel.tag_id and t.owner_id=rel.owner_id where rel.owner_id=#{userId} and rel.resource_type='file' and rel.resource_id=r.id) tags, r.create_time created_at,r.update_time updated_at from px_user_file r where r.owner_id=#{userId} and r.del_flag=0 and r.is_folder=false

select 'article' resource_type, concat('', r.id) id, r.title title, r.content body, r.tag tags, r.create_time created_at, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') updated_at from px_article r where 1 = 1 and r.create_by = #{userId}

select 'diary' resource_type, concat('', r.id) id, coalesce(nullif(r.title, ''), left(r.content, 40)) title, r.content body, '' tags, coalesce(r.create_time, r.date) created_at, coalesce(r.update_time, coalesce(r.create_time, r.date), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') updated_at from px_diary r where 1 = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' and r.create_by = #{userId}

select 'note' resource_type, concat('', r.id) id, r.title title, r.content body, (select group_concat(t.name order by t.normalized_name separator ',') from px_resource_tag_rel rel join px_resource_tag t on t.id=rel.tag_id and t.owner_id=rel.owner_id where rel.owner_id=#{userId} and rel.resource_type='note' and rel.resource_id=r.id) tags, r.create_time created_at, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') updated_at from px_note r where 1 = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' and r.create_by = #{userId}

select 'bookkeeping' resource_type, concat('', r.id) id, concat('¥', r.money) title, r.remark body, c.type_name tags, coalesce(r.create_time, r.pay_time) created_at, coalesce(r.update_time, coalesce(r.create_time, r.pay_time), '1970-01-01 00:00:00') updated_at from px_bookkeeping_record r left join px_bookkeeping_classification c on r.type = c.id and c.create_by = r.create_by where 1 = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' and r.create_by = #{userId}

select 'subscription' resource_type, concat('', r.id) id, r.name title, r.remark body, '' tags, r.create_time created_at, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') updated_at from px_subscription r where 1 = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' and r.create_by = #{userId}

select 'book' resource_type, concat('', r.id) id, r.title title, concat(coalesce(r.author,''), ' ', coalesce(r.description,'')) body, '' tags, r.create_time created_at, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') updated_at from px_book r where 1 = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' and r.create_by = #{userId}

select 'webArticle' resource_type, concat('', r.id) id, r.title title, r.content_text body, r.tags tags, r.create_time created_at, coalesce(r.update_time, r.create_time, '1970-01-01 00:00:00') updated_at from px_web_article r where 1 = 1 and r.del_flag = '0' and r.create_by = #{userId} and exists (select 1 from px_resource_state st where st.user_id=#{userId} and st.resource_type='webArticle' and st.resource_id=r.id and st.opened=#{readFlag}) and exists (select 1 from px_resource_state st where st.user_id=#{userId} and st.resource_type='webArticle' and st.resource_id=r.id and st.starred=#{starFlag})
choose.otherwise: select '' resource_type, '' id, '' title, '' body, '' tags, null created_at, null updated_at where 1 = 0

where.if: and (lower(title) like #{keyword} escape '!' or lower(body) like #{keyword} escape '!' or lower(tags) like #{keyword} escape '!')

and locate(concat(',', #{tag}, ','), concat(',', lower(regexp_replace(trim(replace(replace(replace(replace(coalesce(tags,''), '，', ','), char(9), ' '), char(10), ' '), char(13), ' ')), ' *, *', ',')), ',')) > 0
and exists (select 1 from px_resource_state state where state.user_id=#{userId} and state.resource_type=documents.resource_type and state.resource_id=documents.id and state.inbox=#{inbox})

and exists (select 1 from px_resource_state state where state.user_id=#{userId} and state.resource_type=documents.resource_type and state.resource_id=documents.id and state.last_opened_at is not null)
and not exists (select 1 from px_resource_tag_rel rel where rel.owner_id=#{userId} and rel.resource_type=documents.resource_type and rel.resource_id=documents.id)

mapper.select:
select resource_type, id, title, left(body, 200) snippet, tags, created_at, updated_at from () documents
order by (select state.last_opened_at from px_resource_state state where state.user_id=#{userId} and state.resource_type=documents.resource_type and state.resource_id=documents.id) desc, updated_at desc, resource_type asc, id asc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
